name: Contrôleur d’aplomb
description: Very tall slim adult with long limbs, grey-brown speckled hide, backward swept narrow crest and pointed mandibles, many fine dreads with bronze ties. Long split grey apron over sleeveless dark green tunic, light steel wrist guards. Holds a small steel spirit-level frame with clear glass bubble tube at chest height and a compact plumb bob suspended only to belt level. Focused head tilt.
